title: June close cross-ledger control reconciliation
prompt:
Perform the June 30 close-control reconciliation across cash, AR, AP, debt, and the proposed WIP close.

Begin with the close-status note and controller requests in `Requests/`. Identify the current cash forecast, AR roll-forward, AP cutoff workpaper, debt schedule, WIP policy, PM consolidation, commercial log/support packets, board plan, and flash-review materials. Several nearby files are prior-period, stale, or submitted Q1 versions; determine their permitted use from cutoff and in-file status.

Use the contractor-accounting MCP trial balance and subledgers as the authority for posted actuals. Reconcile each workpaper population, then carry the independently rebuilt proposed WIP adjustment into pro-forma June operating income. Posted and pro-forma values must remain separately labeled.

Report each system/workpaper balance and its control delta, plus the proposed WIP adjustment and pro-forma operating income. Do not edit files or post entries.

Return only one JSON object in your final response with exactly these keys: `system_cash`, `cash_workpaper`, `cash_delta`, `system_ar`, `ar_workpaper`, `ar_delta`, `system_ap`, `ap_workpaper`, `ap_delta`, `system_debt`, `debt_schedule`, `debt_delta`, `proposed_wip_adjustment`, `pro_forma_operating_income`. Use dollar values to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals (for example, return 0.1863 for 18.63%), and dates as YYYY-MM-DD.
